notes: Pages opened (2 of 1-2): List of Zhou dynasty states, Chu (state). No separate Wikipedia article was found under the titles tried, so identity.wikipedia is null; Wikidata id left null (unreachable). SOURCE: one table row, read twice (columns: Name of state | Hanzi | Family | Present location | Title | Start and end year | Conqueror). SLUG yong-hubei, because 'yong' is the Cliopatria row for the Eighteen Kingdoms' Yong (206-204, ea-02). The Chu page is silent on the famine, the alliance and the fate of the land, and on the site; the list gives Qin and Ba as co-conquerors, which the qin and ba dossiers do not show for 611. The start year is a bridge (confidence 1). The chu dossier draws Yong as Shiyan 70 km. The disc and the capital dot are the researcher's reading of the county or town named in the row (coordinates, since the gazetteer lacks most of these places). AREA: none. No rulers, no capitals, no wars on the list.
